title: A French-style garden in Shanghai
summary: Fuxing Park opened in 1909 as Gujiazhai Park, according to Shanghai’s published district history. Its French-style design includes a rose garden, a pond and a rockery. That background offers a way to read the landscape without turning its present-day users into an attraction. The park has a history of its own; a visitor’s brief observation cannot explain the lives of everyone who uses it.
